Build and maintain pipelines of high-caliber pediatric talent through targeted outreach, networking, professional associations, and market mapping. Leverage recruitment analytics, market intelligence, and data-driven insights to advise hiring leaders and optimize search strategies. Partner with clinical leaders and HR teams to coordinate assessment tools, case presentations, and stakeholder interview panels. Provide thoughtful, evidence-based candidate recommendations aligned with the organization’s mission, care standards, and leadership expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Partner with hiring leaders on search strategy, position design, compensation insights, and competitive market trends. Guide leaders through structured interview processes that reduce bias and promote a positive candidate experience. Provide regular updates to executives and leadership teams on search progress, market feedback, and potential challenges. Champion the organization’s mission and values while promoting a compelling and inclusive employer brand. Implement proactive strategies to strengthen leadership pipelines and hiring practices. Build and maintain relationships with pediatric and healthcare leadership communities nationwide. Process Management & Operational Excellence Lead end-to-end search execution, including interview coordination, travel arrangements, candidate communications, and executive scheduling. Manage finalist debriefs, reference checks, compensation alignment, and offer negotiations. Ensure a smooth and engaging onboarding experience by partnering with HR, operations, and hiring leaders to support executive success. White-Glove Recruitment & Candidate Care Deliver a high-touch executive recruitment experience through exceptional communication, responsiveness, and professionalism. Serve as a trusted advisor to candidates, providing clarity, support, and transparency throughout the recruitment and onboarding process. Attributes for Success Polished, service-oriented, and committed to excellence. Strategic yet hands-on, with the ability to balance high-level search strategy and detailed execution. Flexible, resourceful, and persistent in navigating the complexities of pediatric healthcare talent markets. Deeply committed to supporting mission-driven organizations that serve children and families. Requirements Bachelor's degree required; Advanced degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, or related) preferred. 5–10+ years executive search experience required H ealthcare or pediatric environments recruitment preferred Demonstrated success in recruiting for senior leadership roles within complex, highly specialized organizations. Backed by the Nemours Foundation and Alfred I. duPont Trust, our $1.7B nonprofit system is dedicated to improving children's health through clinical care, research, education, advocacy, and prevention. Our Whole Child Health approach focuses equally on prevention and treatment, partnering with communities to help every child thrive. Inclusion and belonging guide our strategy and growth.
